title: GoodWe ESA GW30K-ETA-G20 (30 kW three-phase power module)

items.question: What backup rating does GW30K-ETA-G20 have?
items.answer: On the AC side (Back-up Port) the rated apparent power is 30 kVA. The maximum apparent power is 33 kVA off-grid (45.0 kVA for 10 s) and 55.2 kVA on-grid.
items.answer_de: Auf der AC-Seite (Back-up-Anschluss) beträgt die Nennscheinleistung 30 kVA. Die maximale Scheinleistung beträgt 33 kVA im Off-Grid-Betrieb (45,0 kVA für 10 s) und 55,2 kVA im On-Grid-Betrieb.

citation.title: GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5)

items.question: How many MPPTs does GW30K-ETA-G20 have?
items.answer: The GW30K-ETA-G20 has 4 MPPTs, with 1/1/2/2 strings per MPPT.
items.question_de: Wie viele MPPTs hat der GW30K-ETA-G20?
items.answer_de: Der GW30K-ETA-G20 hat 4 MPPTs, mit 1/1/2/2 Strängen pro MPPT.

citation.title: GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5)

items.question: Which battery modules stack with this power module?
items.answer: The battery system models are GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. Battery modules of different models can be mixed. The system supports 5-108kWh.
items.question_de: Welche Batteriemodule gehören zu diesem Leistungsmodul?
items.answer_de: Die Batteriesystem-Modelle sind GW5.1-BAT-D-G20, GW5.1-BAT-D-G21, GW8.3-BAT-D-G20, GW8.3-BAT-D-G21, GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 und GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. Batteriemodule unterschiedlicher Modelle können gemischt werden. Das System unterstützt 5-108kWh.

citation.title: GoodWe ESA Series 5–30 kW user manual (EN, V1.5)
